title: use-after-free in OrderedDict.copy() on reentrant mutation
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
object: the odict node the copy loop is standing on
lifetime_ender: re-entrant mutation of the source during the copy
shape: pointer load out of a freed block, then followed
note: the spatial arm reads a VALID pointer back and continues, so the unprotected outcome is a plausible wrong answer rather than a crash; both protected arms fault at the labelled BYTE read, before that pointer load can execute, so a protected run shows the stale access refused and not the stale link followed and refused
